description: Optimal planner-executor pattern for Strategy Tactics - uses Gemini 2.0 Flash (2M context) as planner
instructions:
This is a Strategy Tactics card deck. Each card is a complete tactic with:
- Category label (Purpose, Recipe, Identify, Connect, Evolve, Adapt, Plays, Lead)
- Title
- Description
- 5 numbered steps
- Footer (pipdecks.com/...)

Create one chunk per card. Preserve hierarchy and relationships between cards.

notes.why_planner_executor: The planner (Gemini 2.0 Flash with 2M context) reads the ENTIRE 113-page document once and outputs a deterministic chunk plan with byte offsets. The executor (gpt-4o-mini) then does cheap slicing and enrichment. This is much more efficient than processing in segments.
notes.cost_estimate: Planner: ~$0.02 (one pass), Executor: ~$0.05 (enrichment), Total: ~$0.07 vs $0.30+ for segment-based agentic chunking
notes.accuracy: Global context means the planner sees all cards and their relationships, leading to better boundary detection
